content:
A credit has a latest permitted shipment day and a separate expiry day. `amend` takes {field: "latest_shipment_day" or "expiry_day", day: integer} and charges 1,000 USD minor units per amendment. An amendment changes only the selected field; its charge is not refundable.

`present` takes {route_id, amount_minor, certificate_version}. Presentation charges the selected route's fee and produces an UNDER_REVIEW status. The route specifies decision delay. This service processes one presentation per case. On review, shipment must fall within both the latest shipment day and credit expiry; the current insurance certificate must cover at least 110% of invoice value. A discrepant presentation records the failed documentary condition and retains the fee. An accepted presentation credits the declared amount. The bank decides against its own source evidence at the scheduled time; delivery of a separate correspondence copy to support does not gate that decision.

The bank accepts a positive claimed amount up to credit face for documentary examination. The beneficiary remains responsible for subtracting prior advances from its remaining claim. Carrier charges are separate wallet obligations. A faster examination route changes the delay and fee, not the documentary requirements.

Operations are available through `propose_documentary_credit_instruction`. See `TRADE-common` for approval, time and wallet semantics.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_documentary_credit_instruction`

Documentary credit amendments and presentation. Creates an immutable request; customer approval and execute_request perform one local action. See the applicable Trade Services contract for action values and fields.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
